eras._note: 2008-12 to 2012-03 ExpressionEngine site: one page per company at /company/<slug> (74 slugs in the CDX index incl. spelling variants such as covestor/covester, 5min/5min_Media; uppercase slugs like OMGPOP and Altius_Education are not enumerated here and come from the listing era D instead).
2012-04 to 2015-10 WordPress site: post type portfolio, one page per company at /portfolio/<slug>/ (116 slugs in the CDX index); the listing page filters by ?st=<sector>.

2015-11 to 2019 WordPress site (redesign, post type companies): one page per company at /companies/<slug>/ (127 slugs in the CDX index); the listing paginates (/companies/page/N/) and carries sector, geography and a seed/venture/growth stage class per card.

ExpressionEngine listing: a logo slider whose <noscript> block carries one <a href=/company/<slug>/ title="view details for <Name>'s bio"> per company (25 companies in the 2009-06 capture, 41 in 2011-05). Names are the site's own rendering. The first 2012 capture (2012-01) is still the ExpressionEngine page, so the era runs to 2012.

2015-11 to 2019 WordPress listing: <div class='portfolio-list <sector> <geo> <stage>'><a class=portfolio-logos href=/companies/<slug>/ title=Name>. One capture per year reads page 1 only (99-116 cards); the cdx_company_pages era above completes the enumeration and scratch/wp-listing-tags.py reads the per-card sector/geo/stage classes into sources/site/wp-companies-2015-2019.json.

2017-10 to 2019 WordPress redesign (the 'menu-new-menu' theme): /companies/ groups the cards by sector section (<div class='companies-group <sector>'>) with one <li class='companies-list <n> <sector...> <seed|venture|growth>'><a class=portfolio-logos href=<company website> title=Name> per company and no per-company pages; the 2015-2017 theme's /companies/<slug>/ anchors are gone, so this era reads the title attribute. Stage/sector classes read by scratch/wp-listing-tags.py.

2019-09 to 2020-08 interim site built on B12 (jQuery, cdn.b12.io assets): /companies renders one <li class='items-grid__item tag-all tag-stage-<seed|venture|growth> tag-sector-<x>' data-title='<lowercase name>'> per company with a logo link to the company website and no rendered name text; the data-title is read as the slug (display names come from the other eras' renderings). The stage/sector classes are the firm's own labels for the company as listed and are read by scratch/wp-listing-tags.py.

2020+ Webflow site: /companies server-renders every card in every tab (7 tabs in 2021, 6 in 2026), one

Name

per card plus an acquisition-spec line ('NYSE: TWTR in 2013', 'Acquired by Facebook in 2014'). 2007-2008 static PHP site: the homepage (index.php) lists the portfolio as hrefs portfolio/<slug>.php (12 companies in 2007-08). The 2006 site (home.html, image-only portfolio1/2.html pages with per-company /portfolio/<x>.html) is curated by hand into parsed/2006.json from the CDX index (veoh, kickapps, theplatform, twistbox). The domain's 2000-2004 captures belong to a prior owner and predate the firm (founded 2005).

wayback._non_company_note: 'twitter' here is the 2012 /twitter redirect path (the firm's own Twitter account link), not the company; the company row comes from /company/twitter, /portfolio/twitter and the listings. 'investment' and 'operations' are the 2014 team sub-pages.

roster._note: Four people namespaces over twenty years: /team/<first>_<last>.html (2006-07 static, underscores), /team/bio/<firstlast> and /index.php/team/bio/<firstlast> (2008-2011 ExpressionEngine, no separator), /team/<first>-<last>/ (2012-2019 WordPress), /team-profiles/<first>-<last> (2020-2023 Webflow) and /team-members/<first>-<last> (2024+ Webflow). partner-roster.py enumerates the dash-separated namespaces; the 2006-2011 people (Dagres, Politi, Conway, Sabet, Finkelstein, Miller, Borenstein, Koyfman, Go, Parker, Huang, Haber) are CURATED into sources/wayback/partner-roster.json by scratch/roster-curate.py from the CDX capture years of their bio pages (decisions.md D8). The live team.json carries the Webflow tab as group; Operations (finance, platform, marketing) is excluded from the Form D sweep because those people never sit issuer boards for the firm.

site_api._note: sparkcapital.com is a Webflow site (no public CMS API; escalation ladder step 5): /companies server-renders 124 cards across six tabs that repeat the same 45 companies (parsed once into webflow-companies.json with the card's exit marker and website); /team renders 23 people in four tabs. Archived listing eras are read by wayback-pull.py (config.wayback); their per-card fields (Webflow exit markers 2020-2026, WordPress sector/geo/stage classes 2015-2019) are extracted by scratch scripts into further file_list sources added below once landed.
